packageRules.description: astro check doesn't support TypeScript 7 yet ("install TypeScript 6 instead"). Drop this once @astrojs/check does.

The undici override in pnpm-workspace.yaml patches Miniflare's undici 7, which it pins; moving it to 8 would replace a major version Miniflare doesn't expect. Remove the override once Wrangler ships a patched 7.
